# StyleForge
> Transform your images with AI-powered Styles. Upload a photo, choose a curated AI Style, and get a transformed result powered by carefully crafted prompts.

## Core pages
- https://www.styleforge.org/ : AI Image Transformation platform — home page
- https://www.styleforge.org/image-to-image : Upload and transform your photos with AI image-to-image technology
- https://www.styleforge.org/all-styles : Browse all curated AI image transformation styles
- https://www.styleforge.org/create-style : Create your own custom AI Style
- https://www.styleforge.org/pricing : Credit plans and pricing

## Key features
- Image-to-image AI transformation
- Curated AI Styles with carefully crafted prompts
- Custom AI Style creation
- Before/after image comparison
- Credit-based usage system
